name: Vanilla Sprites+
description: Cleans up the games' own Pokémon front sprites. White that is really background trapped inside a sprite (the loop of Articuno's tail, the gap between Mewtwo's arm and body) becomes see-through, on Red/Blue, Yellow, Gold and Silver. In potato_voxel's 3D battles the Pokémon follow the palette you picked instead of staying grey. Built from your own game files at install; no sprite art ships with the mod.
